{"kind":"program","program":"# Run and Validate Athena (Flask/SQLite) in Good vs Bad Security Modes

# Background
Athena is a Python/Flask/SQLite web application intended to help engineers practice application security by comparing an intentionally vulnerable "bad" implementation with a more secure "good" implementation. It runs on Linux and supports an SSL/TLS server variant.

# Use Cases
- Stand up a local lab to practice i
